unit: Behavioral Finance and Financial Stability (Harvard HBS)

labs.research_summary: A project launched in July 2016 at HBS that supports research by Harvard faculty and students on predicting and preventing financial instability, and publishes sentiment and crisis data.
labs.join_notes: Only the school-wide HBS employment page was found; it points to Harvard's online job site and does not mention this project. The About page says the project is supported by postdocs, graduate students and research associates.
